title: Complete conditional mechanism descriptions with shared causal clauses and generated attachments
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, SOURCE_ONLY, NOT SELECTED. Hero Pneumatics sections37–38 supply two complete apparatus descriptions with the same fire-on/open and fire-off/shut endpoints but opposite actuator motions: a water-loaded suspended vessel descends, whereas an expanding leather bag and its closing weight rise. A variable-length whole-content language could preserve component declarations, shared references, couplings, initial conditions, conditional actions, causal explanations, alternatives and reset assertions. This supplies causal constraints beyond generic state names, component-key labels or fixed source token counts. Both whole sections and their owned figures were inspected; the figures are1851 redrawings, not medieval witnesses. No finite cipher or concrete currently-admitted Voynich figure consequence is yet nominated; joint inference remains permitted, and no previously identified word is required. Source dossier records all clause classes, physical and witness uncertainties, independent rivals, and exact predecessor scope.

design.mechanism: A proposed globally shared semantic grammar would generate complete typed apparatus descriptions and conditional operation statements of variable length. Component declarations and repeated clauses may recur; references must denote the same component across the complete text. Types such as rigid chamber, siphon, pulley, counterweight and elastic bag must have fixed operational consequences. Source37 links heated air, liquid transfer, increased suspended mass, descent, opening and return; source38 instead links heated air, bag expansion, ascent and opening. The same attachment relations must explain the reset. Explanatory prose, prerequisite references and explicitly allowed alternatives require declared grammar productions; they cannot be silently dropped as padding. A hypothetical compact semantic language is a new explicit writing model, not a claim to copy the1851 English or historical Greek phonetically. No operation is identified with a Voynich unit in this raw card, and no implementation is supplied.
design.unit: One whole apparatus-and-operation description under independently specified or explicitly hypothesized passage/figure ownership. The source inventory consists of full sections37 and38, including figure ownership, construction clauses, both operational directions, explanations and optional branches. A complete target description may have a different number of clauses or components under the same globally shared grammar; no source count or generated trace length is equated with a target paragraph. Larger text scope must preserve shared component references and code values rather than fit each instance separately.
design.contrast: GDT214 established the historical component-key format while its exact Voynich label-to-prose prediction remained unsupported. GDT885 excludes its exact nontrivial common-endpoint character action on at most3states. GDT903 gives unrestricted reversible endpoint compatibility on10451reachable states without identifying a writing rule or meaning. This candidate would require typed physical attachments and operation-specific intermediate consequences, not merely a common endpoint or a state renaming. IDEA000125 supplies a related whole geometric-output architecture; IDEA000111 already retains generic drawing-operation hypotheses and is not duplicated here. The new content is conditional physical coupling and reset across a complete apparatus description. Its distinct falsifier is proposed, not already frozen or passed. GDT209 supported broad apparatus imagery but lacked its frozen q13-specific homolog. IDEA000039 and IDEA000041 remain untested and concern component/state or isolated topology-category readings; their scope defects and missing endpoints are retained. This proposed full coupled causal program does not merge them or declare those missing bindings solved.
design.prediction: Under one fixed component/operation vocabulary, the complete decoded program must generate its declared attachment graph and all conditional consequences. In the source-derived contrast, fire-on/open alone is inadequate: liquid-transfer actuation predicts a suspended receiving vessel gaining mass and descending, while elastic-bag actuation predicts the bag and closing weight rising. A rival with the same component counts and gross endpoint but reversed operative coupling must yield a different graph or motion. An independently observed figure can constrain attachments and component type even when it does not draw both temporal states; those observable properties must be frozen before testing. Shared code and grammar must generate an independently designated further complete case without new local senses. Mere existence of free masses/volumes making a cycle feasible is too permissive and is not a success condition.
design.scope: Raw conditional architecture, not selected. Unknown: exact finite grammar, global writing rule, source-explanation projection policy, explicit source witness policy, and a nominated observable rival consequence on an admitted whole figure/passage relation. Jointly hypothesizing ownership and code values is allowed; prior known words are not prerequisites. Hero1851 supplies ancient attributed content in a later translation with expressly redrawn figures. The modern BL catalogue dates cited Harley5605 to the16thcentury, contrary to the old appendix; no pre1450 witness of these particular diagrams was established. Preserve the source37 air-through-pores explanation and quicksilver branch as source assertions rather than silently repairing them into modern physics. Static diagrams do not show every initial condition or execution state. No target/reserve access, decoder, new visual admission or automatic reopening is authorized by this raw retention.

source_evidence.quote: Three historical content architectures can express variable-length complete meanings: heraldic descriptions of a whole shield, coupled musical voices, and causal descriptions of a complete mechanism. The strongest new conditional architecture here is a typed causal clause program. None is nominated for an immediate Voynich test: this audit supplies source constraints but no concrete global writing rule with a nominated observable consequence on currently admitted material. That is missing design, not a failed manuscript test or a requirement to know a word beforehand.
